client_implementation.notes: Seventeen shared screens include creator product/rights selection, private samples, separate license/public-copy consent, submission and withdrawal. SAMPLE has seven durable stages, independent frozen costs, five synthetic roles, native PHOTO media/post/QC and sealed double review. Actual produced PNG/MP4 samples also pass approval, independent registered public copying and public byte downloads without new inference. Other publication cases use explicit READY/QC fixtures only in APP_ENV=test. Public copies have frozen 30-day consent, revoke/expiry/rights/resource checks, fenced recovery and late-PUT cleanup; signed deletion replay preserves RETENTION while USER deletion ends distribution. Native UI, generated/audio/custom-resource samples, production Bundle admission and Plus remain incomplete.

generation_implementation.notes: Original production-lease provider gateway and three scoped MCP handlers are implemented. Both video routes require the complete original independent identity report, released instance and actual generated PNGs; immutable prepared evidence binds the report/frame hashes to the paid intent and is revalidated before reservation, send, recovery and media completion. Requests, original ACK/query receipts, task IDs and frozen model/rate contracts are durable; UNKNOWN holds are not rebought. POST reads only completed original outputs. Tool inputs are platform-derived and reject arbitrary prompts/references or silent aspect-ratio changes. The 35 gateway, 6 MCP and 15 reference cases exercise native PostgreSQL/actual PNG-MP4/HTTPS-MCP with synthetic model, usage and isolation responses. Same-generation same-role uniqueness and original shared cost/call limits remain enforced; protocol continuation uses actual stage lease takeover. Complete generative stage orchestration, pack assembly, generated post/QC/final double review/delivery, native audio and real provider admission remain incomplete.

codex_implementation.scope: CONTENT PLAN, PHOTO_LAYOUT PRODUCTION/POST and fresh visual REVIEW_FACTS/REVIEW_STYLE runtime adapters, metered text and sealed-image Responses gateway, atomic PHOTO publication, independent seven-stage creator SAMPLE pipeline
codex_implementation.limited_revision_notes: Five durable REVISION stages produce a new linked PHOTO_LAYOUT/no-speech manifest for existing-image cover selection, full-pack display order or actual replacement copy bytes. Three new synthetic roles review a new sealed packet; original expiry and original delivery remain intact. Pre-sale frozen aftercare costs share the original total budget across failed retries; UNKNOWN holds are not reset. Stage fencing, recovery, late writes and private role graph are exercised. Generated/audio revisions and real Codex/isolation/device verification remain incomplete. Internal traffic is bounded per live run across all four tool/inference routes; invalid/revoked tokens use the shared IP bucket, and durable cost/tool limits still apply.
codex_implementation.notes: Real HTTPS/MCP, synthetic native stdio roles, persisted planning/photo media and complete sealed visual/text review inputs, original receipt recovery, immutable independent reports, fenced atomic publication and authorized hash-checked downloads are exercised. Independent durable reaping uses registered real Node children and test-only cleanup ports; claims, expired-owner rejection, immutable retries and actual directory guards are exercised. All model judgments, token usage and native isolation assertions remain fixtures. Real Codex, restricted OS identity/process-tree cleanup, certified image cost, semantic quality, generated/audio routes and bounded repair remain incomplete.

lifecycle_implementation.notes: Unpaid creation does not extend TTL; paid frozen inputs retain their entitlement. Private keys are written once and registered before I/O. Maintenance verifies original UNKNOWN bytes, settles durable original Codex/vision receipts after role retirement without purchasing inference, and erases exact objects with immutable attempts. Controlled private DB content is redacted only after binaries, instance release, capabilities, tools and billing settle; the original 32-table checks are extended with private SAMPLE source and role graph coverage in a 33-table policy; immutable per-row digest receipts and database guards reject forged receipts or content restoration. A separate signed hash-chain journal, frozen deletion sets, API/Worker/tool admission gates and original-request replay are exercised against an actual native PostgreSQL pg_dump/pg_restore and restored synthetic file bytes. Malformed legacy locators no longer starve other maintenance requests. Completing controlled privacy replay retains a financial recovery hold; only non-production preview with all paid flags disabled can resume. Off-host checkpoint durability, key rotation, power-loss/ACL guarantees, financial restore, WAL/provider/replica copies, real OSS and production isolation remain unverified. Live WRITING, missing/mismatched original bytes and unsettled billing remain blocked; full privacy completion remains false.
